program: Verve N Veda Public Beta Program
purpose: A public summary of Beta Program availability across the Verve N Veda learning and interactive ecosystem.
principles: Provide a consistent Beta Program experience across supported public learning and interactive surfaces.
Use only ordinary public hostname and pathname context to identify where feedback originated.
Exclude learner IDs, family IDs, grades, answers, form values, query strings, hashes, localStorage contents, credentials, and other sensitive information.
Maintain repository-local automation so new visible index pages receive Beta coverage automatically.

coverage_policy.filename_rule: Visible public HTML filenames ending in index.html, including _index.html and common inndex.html typos.
coverage_policy.csp_rule: Pages explicitly forbidding all scripts are not modified automatically.
coverage_policy.future_pages: Repository-local GitHub Actions coverage workflows re-run after pushes so newly added visible index pages are covered automatically.

surfaces.note: Administrative, private/archive, and Beta destination pages are excluded by policy.
